{"code": "import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Deduplicate: keep the row with the highest sample_seq for each patient_id
df_dedup = df.loc[df.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].idxmax()]

# Now compute the fraction of patients with severe baseline disease
n_severe = df_dedup['severity'].eq('severe').sum()
n_total = len(df_dedup)
fraction_severe = n_severe / n_total

print(f"Number of unique patients after deduplication: {n_total}")
print(f"Number with severe baseline: {n_severe}")
print(f"Fraction with severe baseline: {fraction_severe}")"}
